column1: # kimi5 job 37 options spec: ONE row per option. Tab-separated.
# columns: name | lines in r15d | default | min | max | step | bound by | class | in the tune list (yes/no and why)
# "lines in r15d" = the src/search.cpp lines whose literal(s) the option replaces (script-verified).
# "bound by" starts with a kind word the bounds check parses: divisor | index | score | extension | rule | none.
# "one side" inside "bound by" = the row has only one legal direction from default.
# classes: T threshold, A amount, S scale (never an option), R rule/format/size.
# Holds 39 of job 35's 40 options (ImprovingLookbackFallback removed per K2: no legal neighbour inside the
# stack bound; its literal 4 stays in the code at 2034) + 20 new options of K5. TtNear50Clock max 120,
# ImprovingLookback max 4 step 2 (K2), CuckooRepMinClock class R (K1).
# TUNER-STEP RfpWorseningDrop 8: the spec step is 1 by the job's rule; for the next tune I would give 8,
# because +-1 moved the O node sum by only 0.5 % in job 35 (s4 grading) - resolution 1 spends games below
# the noise; step 8 spans [0,100] in 12 moves. The tune list carries this row with step 8.
